name: quantum_teleportation_lab
description: The Quantum Teleportation lesson's lab: a fixed RY message on q0, a pair on q1/q2, Alice's CX and H, the DEFERRED corrections (CX, CZ), q2 measured.

code.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(3, 1)
qc.ry(1.0, 0)
qc.h(1)
qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.h(0)
qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.cz(0, 2)
qc.measure(2, 0)
code.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit.range(3)
# Cirq lists q[0] first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
circuit = cirq.Circuit(
    cirq.ry(1.0)(q[0]),
    cirq.H(q[1]),
    cirq.CNOT(q[1], q[2]),
    cirq.CNOT(q[0], q[1]),
    cirq.H(q[0]),
    cirq.CNOT(q[1], q[2]),
    cirq.CZ(q[0], q[2]),
    cirq.measure(q[2], key="c0"),
)
code.pennylane:
import pennylane as qml

dev = qml.device("default.qubit", wires=3)


@qml.qnode(dev)
def circuit():
    qml.RY(1.0, wires=0)
    qml.Hadamard(wires=1)
    qml.CNOT(wires=[1, 2])
    qml.CNOT(wires=[0, 1])
    qml.Hadamard(wires=0)
    qml.CNOT(wires=[1, 2])
    qml.CZ(wires=[0, 2])
    # measured: q2 -> c0
    return qml.probs(wires=[2])
